description_en: 🏡 Apartment 2+1+2 for sale - Bulevardi i Ri An apartment with a very functional organization is offered for sale, located in one of the areas with the fastest development in Tirana. 📍 Location: Bulevardi i Ri 🏢 Floor: 2 📐 Total area: 116.2 m² 🔹 Organization: ✔️ Spacious living room ✔️ Separate kitchen ✔️ 2 Bedrooms ✔️ 2 Toilets ✔️ Distribution corridor 🚗 Parking post on floor -1 - at extra price 💶 Apartment price: €180,000 The apartment is a very good choice for both family living and for investment, thanks to the strategic location and development of the area.
